description: (Na)₂ScAuF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a ScAuF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the ScAuF₆ framework, Sc is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form ScF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AuF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sc-F bond lengths are 2.02 Å. Au is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AuF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Au-F bond lengths are 2.43 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Sc and one Au atom.
